approval.approvedBy: Phase 10L governance decision; individual approver identity not supplied
approval.rationale: Close the former Phase 10F governance blocker by authorizing least-destructive preservation and exclusion from new Release-4 Product creation, without certifying semantic correctness or authorizing migration, remapping, retirement, installation, or execution.

coveredDispositionRows.coverageRequirement: Each source ledger row in the four listed classifications is covered exactly once; classification is a single-valued source field and the selectors are disjoint. Preserve each selected source row and its original disposition/evidence verbatim; this policy is a separate governance overlay.
coveredDispositionRows.additionalReferenceOnlyIdentityRule: Preserve both referenceOnlyIdentities from the source inventory independently from ledger-row accounting; do not conflate their documentId or payloadId identities with ledger rows or assign targets.

policyRules: Release 4 is authoritative only for new Product creation.
Historical SYSTEM metadata is preserved in the immutable legacy catalogue archive.
Historical Products and Variants are not reclassified or remapped.
Null catalogueFingerprint values are never backfilled or guessed.
Saved historical Product and Variant values remain readable at raw-value level.
Archived legacy metadata is not selectable in Release-4 Create Product flows.
No REVIEW_REQUIRED row is approved for deletion.
No MIGRATION_REQUIRED identity is automatically mapped.
No SAFE_UNREFERENCED_RETIREMENT_CANDIDATE is retired in this release.
Ceiling historical documentId and payloadId identity remain independently preserved.
Basement historical identity remains separate from Release-4 Liquid and Cementitious forms.
All ten protected legacy sync queries remain unchanged.
Future legacy cleanup requires separate explicit cleanup approval.

identitySpecificRules.rule: Do not map the historical Ceiling payload identity to Release 4 by ID similarity; preserve source documentId and payloadId independently in historical evidence/archive.
Do not map historical Basement to either Liquid or Cementitious automatically; preserve source documentId and payloadId independently.
Do not automatically merge any of the ten legacy duplicate pairs.

futureCleanup: Requires a separate explicit cleanup approval with its own reviewed scope and evidence.
